subject_uz: Bank aktivlari sifatini tahlil qilish (AQR) va moliyaviy diagnostika xizmati

requirements.summary_uz: Jamoada magistr darajasi yoki CFA sertifikatiga ega kamida 1 mutaxassis bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The team needs at least 1 specialist with a master's degree or the CFA certificate.
requirements.quote: Magistr darajasiga (MS yoki MF yoki MBA) yoki Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) xalqaro sertifikatiga ega

requirements.summary_uz: Jamoada ACCA Member/Fellow yoki CPA sertifikatiga ega kamida 1 mutaxassis bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The team needs at least 1 specialist with ACCA Member/Fellow or CPA certification.
requirements.quote: ACCA Member yoki ACCA Fellow yoki CPA (Certified Public Accountant) sertifikatiga ega

requirements.summary_uz: Markaziy Osiyodagi kamida 2 ta bank aktivlarini diagnostika qilish (AQR) tajribasi haqida ma'lumot taqdim etiladi.
requirements.summary_en: Information on AQR experience with at least 2 Central Asian banks must be provided.
requirements.quote: kamida 2 ta bankning aktivlarini moliyaviy diagnostika qilish yoki tahlil etish (AQR - asset quality review)

requirements.summary_uz: Jamoada so'nggi 10 yilda MO/MDH/Sharqiy Yevropada kamida 2 ta AQR/Loan review loyihasi tajribasi bo'lgan xodimlar bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The team must have staff with at least 2 AQR/loan review projects in the last 10 years in Central Asia, CIS or Eastern Europe.
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchining jamoasida aktivlar sifatini diagnostika qilish

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi 2025-2026 yillarda bankning tashqi auditori bo'lmasligi kerak (kafolat xati).
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must not be the bank's external auditor for 2025 and 2026 (guarantee letter).
requirements.quote: Не являться аудитором Банка в отношении финансовой отчетности за 2025 и 2026 финансовые годы.

requirements.summary_uz: Moliyaviy hisobotlar (auditor tasdiqlagan yoki soliq organi qabul qilgan) taqdim etiladi.
requirements.summary_en: Financial statements (audited or accepted by the tax authority) must be provided.
requirements.quote: Молиявий ҳисоботлар (ташқи аудитор ташкилотлар томонидан тасдиқланган ёки солиқ органлари томонидан қабул қилинганлиги тасдиқланган ҳолда) мавжудлиги

requirements.summary_uz: Yakka baholash uchun tanlanma korporativ kredit portfelining kamida 60-70 foizini qamrab olishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The sample for individual review must cover at least 60-70 percent of the corporate loan portfolio.
requirements.quote: для индивидуальной оценки должно покрывать не менее 60-70% корпоративного кредитного портфеля

requirements.summary_uz: Ishlar shartnoma imzolangach darhol boshlanib, 2026-yil 25-dekabrgacha tugashi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Work starts immediately on signing and must finish by 25 December 2026.
requirements.quote: Ishlar shartnoma imzolanishi bilan darhol boshlanib, 2026-yil 25-dekabrgacha yakunlanishi lozim.

requirements.summary_uz: Shartnomadan keyin 15% avans; qolgan qismi hisobot qabul qilingach to'lanadi.
requirements.summary_en: 15 percent advance after contract; the rest after the report is accepted.
requirements.quote: После оформления договора производится предоплата в размере 15%;

requirements.summary_uz: Asosiy sessiyalarda o'zbek yoki rus tilida so'zlashuvchi ekspertlar qatnashishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: Uzbek- or Russian-speaking experts must attend the key sessions.
requirements.quote: Обязательное присутствие узбекско/русскоязычных экспертов на ключевых сессиях.

requirements.summary_uz: Boshqa tilda taqdim etilgan hujjatlar o'zbek yoki rus tiliga tarjima qilinmasa inobatga olinmaydi.
requirements.summary_en: Documents in other languages that are not translated into Uzbek or Russian are disregarded.
requirements.quote: Boshqa tillarda taqdim etilgan hujjatlarlar inobatga olinmaydi va ishtirokchi tanlovdan

requirements.summary_uz: Mezonlarga javob bergan eng arzon narx taklif qilgan ishtirokchi g'olib bo'ladi (boshlang'ich narx 3,6 mlrd so'm).
requirements.summary_en: The cheapest bidder meeting the criteria wins (start price 3.6 billion UZS).
requirements.quote: Xarid hujjati mezonlari talablarini bajargan eng arzon narx taklifini taqdim etgan ishtirokchi

flags.quote: Markaziy Osiyodagi banklardan kamida 2 ta bankning aktivlarini moliyaviy diagnostika qilish va/yoki tahlil etish (AQR- asset quality review) tajribasiga ega yetakchi xalqaro kompaniyalardan biri
flags.explanation_uz: Ishtirokchi Markaziy Osiyoning kamida 2 ta bankida AQR tajribasiga ega bo'lishi va 'yetakchi xalqaro kompaniya' bo'lishi shart, jamoa uchun esa MO/MDH/Sharqiy Yevropadagi loyihalar yetarli. Hududni Markaziy Osiyo bilan cheklash va 'yetakchi' degan o'lchovsiz so'z boshqa mintaqalarda shunday loyihalarni bajargan malakali kompaniyalarni chetlatishi mumkin.
flags.explanation_en: The bidder itself must have AQR experience at 2 or more Central Asian banks and be a 'leading international company', while for the team projects in Central Asia, CIS or Eastern Europe suffice. Limiting the region to Central Asia and the unmeasured word 'leading' may exclude capable firms that did equivalent work elsewhere.
flags.rewrite_uz: Ishtirokchi so'nggi 10 yilda kamida 2 ta bank aktivlari sifatini tahlil qilish (AQR) loyihasini (Markaziy Osiyo, MDH, Sharqiy Yevropa yoki boshqa o'xshash bozorlarda) bajarganini hujjatlar bilan tasdiqlashi kifoya.
flags.rewrite_en: It is enough for the bidder to document at least 2 bank asset quality review projects in the last 10 years (in Central Asia, CIS, Eastern Europe or comparable markets).

flags.quote: Ishlar shartnoma imzolanishi bilan darhol boshlanib, 2026-yil 25-dekabrgacha yakunlanishi lozim.
flags.explanation_uz: Takliflar 20-noyabrda yopiladi, baholash 10 ish kunigacha, e'tiroz uchun 2 ish kuni va shartnoma imzolash uchun 10 ish kuniga qadar vaqt ketadi, shundan so'ng ishlar 25-dekabrgacha, ya'ni bir necha haftada tugashi kerak. Xarid hujjati boshqa joyda ishlar 3 oydan oshmasligini aytadi; yuz nafargacha qarz oluvchini tahlil qiladigan loyiha uchun bu muddat jamoani oldindan tayyorlagan ishtirokchilarnigina ushlab qoladi.
flags.explanation_en: Bids close on 20 November, evaluation can take up to 10 working days, objections 2 working days and signing up to 10 working days, leaving only a few weeks to finish by 25 December. The procurement document elsewhere says up to 3 months; for a review of up to 100 borrowers this window favours only bidders with a team already prepared.
flags.rewrite_uz: Ishlarni yakunlash muddati shartnoma imzolangan kundan boshlab hisoblangan aniq davr (masalan, 3 oy) sifatida belgilansin va xarid hujjatidagi 3 oy bilan mos kelsin.
flags.rewrite_en: Set the completion time as a fixed period counted from contract signing (for example 3 months), consistent with the 3 months stated in the procurement document.

flags.quote: Takliflarni qabul qilish muddati va vaqti: takliflar etender.uzex.uz platformasida tanlash e’lon qilingan kundan boshlab 5 ish kunida elektron ko‘rinishda taqdim etiladi.
flags.explanation_uz: Takliflar e'lon qilingandan keyin atigi 5 ish kuni ichida topshirilishi kerak. Taklif tarjima qilingan sertifikatlar, mutaxassislar rezyumelari, 6 ta shakl va tajriba hujjatlarini o'z ichiga oladi, shuning uchun bu muddat 3,6 mlrd so'mlik murakkab xizmat uchun qisqa bo'lishi mumkin.
flags.explanation_en: Offers must be filed within only 5 working days of the announcement. The package includes translated certificates, specialist CVs, six forms and experience documents, so this may be short for a complex 3.6 billion UZS service.
flags.rewrite_uz: Takliflarni topshirish muddati kamida 10 ish kuni qilib belgilansin.
flags.rewrite_en: Set the offer submission period to at least 10 working days.

flags.quote: Jahonning oliy ta’lim muassasalarida magistrlik (MS va/yoki MF va/yoki MBA) darajasiga va Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) xalqaro sertifikatiga ega
flags.explanation_uz: Texnik topshiriqda mutaxassis ham magistr darajasiga, ham CFA sertifikatiga ega bo'lishi kerak, platforma shaklida esa 'yoki' yozilgan. Bu nomuvofiqlik, shuningdek 'jahonning oliy ta'lim muassasalari' o'lchovsiz ibora, talabni noaniq qiladi va ishtirokchi rad etilishi xavfini tug'diradi.
flags.explanation_en: The technical specification requires a specialist with both a master's degree and the CFA certificate, while the platform form says 'or'. This mismatch, and the unmeasured phrase 'world's higher education institutions', make the requirement unclear and could lead to a bidder being rejected.
flags.rewrite_uz: Mutaxassis magistr darajasiga yoki CFA sertifikatiga ega bo'lishi kifoya, deb platforma shakli va texnik topshiriqda bir xil yozilsin.
flags.rewrite_en: State identically in the platform form and the specification that a master's degree or the CFA certificate is sufficient.

documents_needed_uz: Davlat ro'yxatidan o'tganlik haqidagi hujjat va ta'sis hujjatlari
Markaziy Osiyodagi banklar bo'yicha tajriba haqida ma'lumot (4-shakl) va tasdiqlovchi shartnoma, hisob-faktura yoki dalolatnomalar nusxalari
Texnik topshiriq va xarid hujjatiga muvofiqlik haqida kafolat xati (6-shakl)
Magistr darajasi yoki CFA, ACCA yoki CPA sertifikatlari va diplom nusxalari (o'zbek yoki rus tiliga tarjimada)
Aktivlar sifatini diagnostika qilish bo'yicha tajribali xodimlar mavjudligi haqida kafolat xati
Bankning tashqi auditori bilan aloqasi yo'qligi haqida kafolat xati
Moliyaviy hisobotlar (buxgalteriya balansi, moliyaviy natijalar to'g'risidagi hisobot) yoki auditorlik xulosasi
